buildCommand: git config --global url."https://${GIT_SUBMODULE_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/" && git submodule update --init --remote --recursive && node scripts/sync-images.mjs && next build

headers.value: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; font-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'
accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()
